blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Mathematical modeling turns an open-ended real-world problem into assumptions, a model, a solution, and a defended recommendation, and its answers matter only if they are both close to a credible reference and physically feasible; existing benchmarks either score solver fragments or grade reports with an LLM judge, leaving those numbers unchecked. We introduce TB-MathModel (the Terminal-style Mathematical Modeling Bench), the first benchmark to make complete contest-style modeling problems agentic, verifiable, and terminal at once, over 18 real CUMCM and MCM problems (2023--2025). Each task ships the verbatim statement, official attachments, and figures in a containerized terminal; the agent returns one JSON artifact, scored on the numeric core of the final question against a reproduction of the Outstanding-award paper. Two design choices distinguish it: direction-aware, one-sided scoring, which never penalises beating the anchor, and two-layer feasibility verification---a programmatic gate over six decidable invariant forms plus 624 Lean~4 obligations---with a hard gate that zeroes infeasible answers. Each task is scored against a panel of human outstanding papers rather than one, so a model must be close to many accepted answers; across seven multimodal entries (three seeds each) the strongest reach a multi-reference O-Eval of 64.58\%, while the \$2.54 open model holds 59.81\% at $1/100$ the cost. TB-MathModel turns the numeric core of modeling into a reproducible, machine-checkable signal for measuring long-horizon modeling competence and for collecting agent trajectories. The source code is available at https://github.com/wxj630/terminal-bench-math-modeling.
blocks.zh: 数学模型化将一个没有限制的现实世界问题转变为假设、模型、解决方案和被辩护的建议,其答案只有在既接近可信的参考,又在物理上可行的情况下才重要;现有的基准要么是分数解决者碎片,要么是使用LLM法官的分数报告,使这些数字不受限制。 我们引入了TB-Math Model(终端式数学模拟座椅),这是第一个使完整的竞赛式模拟问题具有代理性,可核查性,并同时具有终端性的基准,超过18个真正的CUMCM和MCM问题(2023-2025年). 每个任务将逐字记录、正式附件和数字装入集装箱式终端;代理人返回一个JSON文物,在最后问题的数字核心上得分,而不是复制一份杰出奖状。 两个设计选择区别于它:方向意识,片面评分,它从来不会惩罚击败锚,两个层次的可行性验证——一个方案门,它比六个可破解的无变体外加624 Lean~4义务外加一个硬门,这个硬门是零不可行的答案. 每项任务都是对照一组人类杰出的论文而不是一张打分,所以一个模型必须接近许多被接受的答案;通过7个多式联运条目(每个种子3个),最强者达到64.58\%的多参照O-Eval,而\$2.54的开放式模型则以1/100美元的成本持有59.81\%. TB-MathModel将建模的数值核心转换成可复制的,机器可检查的信号,用于测量长视距建模能力并收集剂轨迹. 源代码见https://github.com/wxj630/terminal-bench-math-modeling.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Mathematical modeling contests such as CUMCM in China and MCM/ICM internationally ask teams to convert a deliberately under-specified real-world problem into a defensible quantitative answer within days. The deliverable is not a single number but a chain: assumptions → \rightarrow model → \rightarrow solution → \rightarrow sensitivity → \rightarrow recommendation. Two properties make it an attractive target for agent evaluation: it is quantitative , because the final question ends in numbers that can be checked, and it is multimodal , because statements reference figures and attachments are spreadsheets and CSVs. It also differs from solving a well-posed problem in where the hard work begins —the model itself must be built, and the same situation admits time-series, optimization, dynamical, graph, or multi-criteria formulations, any of which can be defensible if its assumptions are explicit and its computation credible Giordano et al. (2014) ; Meerschaert (2013) . This is what makes modeling a demanding test of long-horizon agents: hold the statement and attachments in context, choose a formulation, write and run code, handle files and units, and report a self-consistent answer.
blocks.zh: 中国CUMCM等数学建模比赛和MCM/ICM国际要求团队在数日内将有意未明确的真实世界问题转换为可辩驳的量化答案. 交付品不是单数而是一连串:假设 → 右倾模型 → 右倾解决方案 → 右倾灵敏度 → 右倾建议 . 两个属性使它成为代理评价的有吸引力的目标:它是定量的,因为最后一个问题以可以检查的数字结尾,它是多式的,因为报表引用数字和附件是电子表格和CSV. 它还不同于解决一个在艰苦工作开始的地方可能存在的问题——模型本身必须被构建,同样的情况也承认时间序列,优化,动态,图表,或多标准配方,如果其假设明确,且计算可信,那么任何一种配方都可以被反驳(2014年);Meerschaert (2013)。 这使得模型对长视特务进行要求很高的测试:按上下文来保存语句和附件,选择配方,写出并运行代码,处理文件和单位,并报告一个自相矛盾的答案.

blocks.en: Existing benchmarks cover adjacent but distinct ground, and none closes the loop we care about. Code, terminal, and assistant benchmarks score repository edits, command-line competence, and tool use Jimenez et al. (2024) ; Merrill et al. (2026) ; Mialon et al. (2024) ; Yao et al. (2025) ; closed-form mathematics benchmarks score deduction rather than modeling Hendrycks et al. (2021) ; Cobbe et al. (2021) ; Glazer et al. (2024) ; operations-research datasets parse word problems into solver-ready formulations Ramamonjison et al. (2023) ; AhmadiTeshnizi et al. (2024) ; Yang et al. (2025) . The closest prior work on modeling itself falls into two camps, neither simultaneously agentic, verifiable, terminal, and multimodal. One stays solver-facing and narrow, scoring a single formal artifact Huang et al. (2025b) . The other grades the final report with an LLM judge Qian et al. (2025) ; Liu et al. (2025) , rewarding fluent prose without establishing that the reported numbers are correct or even admissible. Table 1 makes the gap concrete; TB-MathModel is the first to combine all of these properties.

blocks.en: Closing the gap raises three problems that shape the design. Different teams make different assumptions, so there is no single ground truth: rather than promote one paper to truth, TB-MathModel asks every human expert , scoring each task against a panel of outstanding solutions so that a model must be close to many accepted answers, not match one. Anchoring creates asymmetric failure—a model that does better than the paper can score worse than one that copies it—so TB-MathModel makes each metric’s direction explicit and scores one-sidedly. And a wrong-but-plausible answer is easy to produce (numbers that look reasonable yet violate the problem’s physics), which anchor comparison cannot catch, so TB-MathModel adds an independent feasibility layer.
blocks.zh: 缩小差距提出了塑造设计的三个问题. TB-MathModel向每位人类专家提问, 将每个任务评分到一组杰出的解决方案上, Anchoring 制造出不对称的故障 — — 一个比报纸更好的模型比复制它的一个模型更差 — — 因此TB-Math Model使每个度量标准的方向明确,并单向得分。 而错误的但可信的答案很容易产生(数字看起来合理却违反问题的物理),而这种数据无法锁定比较,因此TB-MathModel增加了一个独立的可行性层。

blocks.en: We present TB-MathModel (Terminal-style Mathematical Modeling Bench), to our knowledge the first benchmark to turn complete contest-style mathematical modeling problems into an agentic, verifiable, terminal evaluation. It contributes: 1. The first benchmark of its kind, and the 18-task dataset behind it. No prior benchmark turns complete contest-style modeling problems into a containerized terminal task with an executable verifier. TB-MathModel covers CUMCM and MCM 2023–2025 (problems A/B/C each year), with verbatim statements, official attachments, 21 figures cropped from the PDFs, and one JSON artifact per task. 2. Direction-aware, one-sided scoring with auditable edge-case rules. Per-metric semantic directions ( higher/lower_is_better , target_value , exact_value ); two reported metrics ( O-Eval , Robust BO-Eval ); explicit rules for degenerate bands and unpinned reference units; and contract tests that lock the two defining properties down. 3. A two-layer feasibility verification design. A programmatic gate covering 18/18 tasks through six decidable invariant forms, and a Lean 4 certificate layer of 624 kernel-checked obligations; the two layers decide every feasibility question a structured artifact can settle, and state exactly where an independent replay takes over. 4. An empirical study of seven multimodal model/harness entries , each averaged over three seeds, with per-task behaviour, a cost–robustness analysis, and three case studies; we also document the scoring pitfalls we found and fixed and quantify which move the leaderboard.
blocks.zh: 我们提出TB-Math Model(终极式数学建模座椅),据我们所知,这是把完整的竞赛式数学建模问题变成一种代理性、可核查的终极评价的第一个基准。 它有助于: 1. 第一个此类基准及其背后的18个任务数据集。 任何先前的基准都无法将完全的相竞式的建模问题转变为带有可执行核查器的集装箱式终端任务. TB-MathModel涵盖CMM和MCM 2023–2025(问题A/B/C每年),包括逐字记录、正式附件、从PDF中抽取的21个数字以及JSON每件工作一件文物。 2. 方向意识、有可审计边缘情况规则的单方面评分。 测量语义方向(高/下_is_better ,目标-值,精确-值);两个已报告的度量(O-Eval,Robust BO-Eval);退化带和无固定参考单位的明确规则;以及将两个定义属性锁定在下的合同测试. 3. 双层可行性核查设计。 方案门通过6个可解析的不变量形式涵盖18/18个任务,并有624个内核检查义务的Lean 4证书层;两层决定每个可行性问题,一个结构化的文物可以解决,并确切说明独立重播的接收地点. 4. 对7个多式联运模式/缺陷条目进行的经验研究,每个条目平均有3个种子,每个任务都有行为、成本 -- -- 风险分析以及3个案例研究;我们还记录了我们发现的得分陷阱,并固定和量化了移动领导板。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Software-engineering and terminal agents are measured by repository-level tasks (SWE-bench Jimenez et al. (2024) ) and end-to-end command-line tasks (Terminal-Bench Merrill et al. (2026) ); assistants by tool-use suites such as GAIA Mialon et al. (2024) and τ \tau -bench Yao et al. (2025) . Machine-learning and data-science agents are measured on Kaggle-style pipelines Chan et al. (2025) ; Starace et al. (2025) ; Guo et al. (2024) ; Zhang et al. (2024) ; Gu et al. (2024) ; Hu et al. (2024) ; Li et al. (2024) . These capture tool use and long-horizon execution in a container—the harness we build on—but score a leaderboard position or a rubric over a deliverable, never a modeling artifact, and attach no feasibility contract.
blocks.zh: 软件工程和终端代理通过寄存层任务(SWE-bench Jimenez等 (2024))和端到端指令行任务(Terminal-Bench Merrill等 (2026))进行测量;助手通过GAIA Mialon等(2024)和\tau-bench Yao等(2025)工具使用套件进行测量. 在Kaggle式管道上测量机器学习和数据科学剂 Chan等 (2025年); Starace等 (2025年); Guo等 (2024年); Zhang等 (2024年); Gu等 (2024年); Hu等 (2024年); Li等 (2024年). 这些捕捉工具的使用和在容器中的长距离处决——即我们利用的绳索——但得分是领跑板的位置或标语,而不是交付品,绝不是模型文物,并且不附加任何可行性合同。

blocks.en: Closed-form mathematics benchmarks measure deduction, not modeling Hendrycks et al. (2021) ; Cobbe et al. (2021) ; Glazer et al. (2024) ; Zheng et al. (2022) . Operations-research systems parse word problems into solver-ready formulations and evaluate optimality or feasibility of a given formulation Ramamonjison et al. (2023) ; Xiao et al. (2024) ; AhmadiTeshnizi et al. (2024) ; Yang et al. (2025) ; Huang et al. (2025a) ; Mostajabdaveh et al. (2025) ; Lima et al. (2025) ; Xiao et al. (2025) . They supply a strong execution-validity precedent—a solver certifies a solution is feasible or optimal for a stated model —but cannot certify that the model captures the right abstraction, and none requires assumptions, sensitivity analysis, or a defended recommendation.
blocks.zh: 闭式数学基准量取法,不以Hendrycks等为模型(2021);Cobbe等为模型(2021);Glazer等为模型(2024);Zheng等为模型(2022)。 操作-研究系统将单词问题分解为溶解剂的配方,并评价给定配方的优化性或可行性 Ramamonjison等 (2023年); 肖等 (2024年); 艾哈迈迪·特什尼齐等 (2024年); 杨等 (2025年); 黄等 (2025年a年); 穆斯塔贾布达维等 (2025年); 利马等 (2025年); 肖等 (2025年). 它们提供了一个有力的执行有效性先例——一个解决者证明一个解决方案对于一个所声明的模型是可行的或最佳的——但不能证明该模型抓住了正确的抽象,也没有一个需要假设、敏感性分析或辩护性建议。

blocks.en: The closest work forms a continuum, and none of it is simultaneously agentic, verifiable, and terminal. Mamo Huang et al. (2025b) is solver-grounded : models emit solver-consumable artifacts and the solver is a falsifiable checker, giving a precise but narrow signal on formal fragments rather than whole contest problems. ModelingAgent and its ModelingBench Qian et al. (2025) are report-level : open-ended problems graded by an expert-style LLM judge—ecologically rich but judge-calibration dependent and non-reproducible. MM-Agent and MM-Bench Liu et al. (2025) add a hierarchical modeling library, yet their primary evaluation remains a report rubric. TB-MathModel keeps the full contest statement and the agentic workflow, pins evaluation to a structured artifact scored by an executable verifier, and adds a feasibility layer neither camp provides.
blocks.zh: 最接近的工作形成了一个连续体,其中没有一个是同时具有活性、可核查性和终端性的。 妈妈 Huang 等 (2025b) 为解析器定位 :模型释放出解析器消耗性文物,解析器为可伪造的检查器,在正文片段上给出精确而狭义的信号而不是整个相竞问题. 建模代理及其建模Bench Qian等人(2025年)是报告一级:由专家式的LLM法官分级的开放式问题——生态丰富但法官的校准依赖性和非出版性。 MM-Agent和MM-Bench Liu等人(2025年)增加了一个分级建模库,然而他们的首要评价仍然是一个报告标题. TB-MathModel保存了完整的参赛语句和代理工作流程,将评价钉入可执行验证器所打出的结构化文物上,并增加了两个阵营都没有提供的可行性层.

blocks.en: Theorem provers such as Lean 4 de Moura and Ullrich (2021) with Mathlib The mathlib Community (2020) have certified competition and research mathematics, and RL over formal proof has produced strong provers Hubert et al. (2025) ; Xin et al. (2024) . Using a prover not to find answers but to audit a benchmark’s own feasibility decisions is, to our knowledge, new: our Lean layer re-proves the programmatic gate’s invariants, so an assertion becomes a machine-checkable fact Sutton (2001) , at integer-and-rational arithmetic cost the kernel decides without the full library.
blocks.zh: 与 Mathlib 一起进行定理证明,如Lean 4 de Moura和Ullrich (2021) Mathlib社区(2020年)拥有认证的竞争和研究数学,RL过正式证明产生了强大的证明人Hubert等 (2025年);Xin等 (2024年). 使用一个证明器,不是找到答案,而是审计一个基准本身的可行性决定,据我们所知,这是新的:我们精益层重新证明了程序闸门的变异性,因此一个断言变成了一个机器可以检查的事实Sutton(2001年),即内核在没有完整库的情况下决定的整数和合理算术成本。

blocks.en: Tool-using agents increasingly externalize their state for reuse Yao et al. (2023) ; Wei et al. (2022) ; Schick et al. (2023) ; Zhou et al. (2026) . TB-MathModel makes visual evidence load-bearing—figures are cropped from the official PDFs—so harnesses with and without an image channel can be compared on identical tasks. Anchoring a numerical benchmark on a published solution is standard practice; we show it creates three under-reported hazards (direction asymmetry, degenerate scoring bands, unpinned units) and give auditable rules and tests for each.
blocks.zh: 工具使用剂日益将其状态外部化用于再利用 姚等 (2023年); 魏等 (2022年); 施克等 (2023年); 周等 (2026年). TB-Math Model 制作视觉证据负载图, 在已公布的解决方案上确定一个数字基准是标准做法;我们显示,它造成了三个未充分报告的危险(方向不对称、分数差、无标值单位),并为每个危险提供可审计的规则和测试。

blocks.en: 3 The TB-MathModel Benchmark
blocks.zh: 3. TB-Math Model基准

blocks.en: TB-MathModel (the Terminal-style Mathematical Modeling Bench) turns each contest problem into a self-contained terminal task. Figure 2 summarises the construction pipeline. A build script assembles the official contest material into four parts: (i) an instruction file with the verbatim statement and its figures; (ii) an agent container holding the mirrored attachments and an output schema; (iii) a separate verifier container holding the scoring panel and an executable feasibility check; and (iv) an oracle that reproduces the Outstanding-award (O-award) paper. The agent is dropped into the terminal with this material and must return a single structured artifact. Everything downstream of the artifact—scoring and feasibility—is machine-executable.
blocks.zh: TB-Math Model(终极式数学模拟座椅)将每个比赛问题都变成了自成一体的终端任务. 图2概述了施工管道。 建材脚本将正式比赛材料组装为四个部分: (一)带有逐字记录及其数字的指令文件; (二)带有镜像附件和输出图案的代理容器; (三)单独装有评分板和可执行可行性检查的核查容器; (四)复制出品奖(O-Award)纸的甲骨文. 剂用这种材料被投入终端,必须归还单一的结构化文物. 文物下游的一切——评分和可行性——都是机器可以执行的.

blocks.en: Figure 2: The TB-MathModel construction and evaluation pipeline. Build : official statements, attachments, and PDF figures are compiled into a task directory. Run : the agent works inside a network-isolated terminal container and writes one JSON artifact. Evaluate : the artifact is scored by a direction-aware, one-sided panel against an O-award reproduction, and independently checked by a programmatic feasibility gate plus a Lean 4 certificate layer; a failed gate zeroes the task.
blocks.zh: 图2:TB-MathModel建造和评价管道。 Build : 官方语句,附件,和 PDF 数字被汇编成任务目录. 运行:代理在网络同位化终端容器内工作,并写出一幅JSON出品. 评分:文物由方向感知器打分,单面面面板对接O-ward复制品,由程序可行性门外加Lean 4证书层独立检查;故障门将任务零.

blocks.en: TB-MathModel comprises 18 tasks : the A, B, and C problems of CUMCM and MCM for each of 2023–2025. We restrict to the last three years on purpose: older problems predate capable LLMs and were calibrated to software-assistant graders, so their task mix and review standard differ from the post-LLM regime, and recent editions are harder and more discriminating. The two contests complement each other—CUMCM is engineering/optimization-heavy and Chinese, MCM is modeling-flavored and English—and taking all three problems of each year covers the standard “A = physical/engineering, B = data/optimization, C = data-science” split without cherry-picking. Statements and attachments are mirrored verbatim; a statement’s figures are cropped from the official PDF (artwork plus its caption) and delivered inline and at stable container paths. 21 unique figures across 6 tasks are load-bearing : the statements reference them for geometry not restated in text (e.g., the dragon-dance U-turn curve, which fixes the final head speed), so a harness without an image channel cannot recover it—hence the multimodal evaluation. TB-MathModel is a pure evaluation set, with no training split or difficulty tiering (Appendix A ).
blocks.zh: TB-MathModel包含18项任务:2023-2025年CUMCM和MCM的A、B和C问题。 我们只限在过去三年中故意:老问题早于有能力的LLMs,并被校准为软件助理分级员,因此他们的任务组合和审查标准与LLM后制度不同,而最近版本更困难,更具有歧视性. 两场比赛互为补充——CUMCM是工程/优化-重力和中文,MCM是建模-口味和英语——每年的三个问题都涵盖标准"A=物理/工程,B=数据/优化,C=数据-科学",没有选樱桃. 声明和附件是逐字反映的;声明的数字来自官方的PDF(艺术加标题),在内部和稳定的集装箱路径上提供。 6个任务的21个独特数字是负载的:语句参考它们来表示没有在文本中重现的几何(例如:龙舞U-turn曲线,它固定了最终的头快),所以没有图像通道的绳索无法恢复——因此是多模式评价. TB-MathModel是一个纯粹的评价集,没有训练分裂或难度分级(附录A.).

blocks.en: The scored object is one JSON file per task, whose schema (field names and types only) is shipped to the agent; extra CSV/XLSX/PNG artifacts are not scored. A schema-constrained JSON is what makes an automated score possible, at the cost of mapping a free-form effort onto named numeric fields—a tension we revisit in Section 4.3 . Each task is anchored to one O-award paper, re-implemented as a script that reads the attachments and emits the same JSON; the reproduction is the normalisation endpoint ( O-Eval = 100 % =100\% ) and sets the per-metric panel, coverage 18/18 . Provenance is a first-class field—paper id, PDF/OCR source, and reproduction scope—so any anchor can be re-derived (Appendix D ); this is what let us catch and correct an infeasible dragon-dance anchor before it reached the board.
blocks.zh: 得分的对象是每个任务一个JSON文件,其计划(只有域名和类型)被运入代理;额外的CSV/XLSX/PNG文物没有得分. JSON计划使自动得分成为可能,其代价是将自由形式的努力绘制在命名的数字字段上——我们在第4.3节中再次提到这种紧张。 每个任务被固定在一张O-Award纸上,重新被作为脚本执行,读取附件并发出相同的JSON;复制是正态化的终点(O-Eval = 100% = 100\%)并设定了每度面板,覆盖度为18/18. 证明是一等场——纸质id、PDF/OCR源和复制范围——这样任何锚都可以被再生(Appendix D),这就是让我们在到达董事会之前抓住并纠正一个不可行的龙舞锚。

blocks.en: 3.1 Scoring: direction-aware, one-sided, auditable
blocks.zh: 3.1 分红:方向意识、单方面、可审计

blocks.en: A naive distance-to-anchor metric silently rewards copying and punishes improvement, so TB-MathModel scores each task through a per-metric panel with an explicit semantic direction. Each task ships a panel of 2–6 scored metrics (60 in total), each with a path into the artifact, an anchor value O O , a direction, and a weight. A metric is higher_is_better , lower_is_better , target_value (closest to O O wins), or exact_value , set from the modeling semantics of the quantity rather than the sign of its value. Directional metrics use an asymmetric, one-sided reward: meeting or beating the anchor never scores below 1.0 1.0 , so improving on the paper is never punished (full formulas in Appendix G ).
blocks.zh: 一种天真相距比喻无声地奖励抄袭和惩罚改进,因此TB-MathModel通过一个有明确语义方向的每分量的面板来评分每个任务. 每个任务都装有2到6分的分数(总共60分)的面板,每个面板都有进入文物的路径、锚值O O、方向和重量。 一个度量值是更高_is_beters,更低_is_beters,目标-值(最接近 O 胜出),或精确_值,设定自量的建模语义而不是其值的标志. 定向度量衡使用不对称的,片面的奖励:相会或击败主锚的分数永远不低于1.0-1.0-,因此纸面上的改进永远不会受到惩罚(附录G中的完整公式).

blocks.en: Three failure modes recur often enough to deserve named rules. (i) Degenerate bands: a band narrower than 2% of the value magnitude cannot discriminate, so we widen it to 5%—this changed one cell (stair-wear, → 73.52 72.67\!\to\!73.52 ). (ii) Non-comparable units: when an anchor is an arbitrary raw index with no schema-pinned unit (a host-fish index of 1080), a model reporting the same quantity normalised to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] is not wrong, so such metrics are dropped for every model and the oracle by a configuration-only rule. (iii) Cardinality mismatch: surplus items are excluded rather than counted missing. Out-of-domain values (a correlation outside [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] , a negative count) score zero, with the reason recorded.
blocks.zh: 三种失败模式经常重现,以至于理应得到命名规则。 (一)减值分幅:比值级小于2%的分幅不能区分,所以我们将其扩大至5%—,这改变了一格(楼梯-服,~73.52 72.67\!to\!73.52). (二)不可比较的单位:当锚是任意的原始指数,没有被设定的单位(主机-鱼指数为1080)时,一个报告相同数量正常化为[0, 1] [0,1]的模型并不错误,因此,每个模型和甲骨文的这种度量都是通过一个只有配置的规则而放弃的. (三) 主教座标不匹配:剩余项目不包括在内,不计算缺失。 域外值(外接[− 1, 1] [-1, 1, 负数] 得分为零, 原因记录.

blocks.en: 3.2 Multi-references evaluation
blocks.zh: 3.2 多参考评价

blocks.en: Modeling has no single correct answer, so a benchmark that normalises against one paper silently converts one team’s choices into ground truth. TB-MathModel instead asks every human expert. For each task we extracted the final-question values reported by all available Outstanding-award papers for that problem, giving 99 panel papers, 94 of which yield the scored quantity . Coverage is 18/18 tasks and all available outstanding papers are used —1 to 18 per task (median 4), since the number of O-award reports differs by problem. Each paper is one vote.

blocks.en: A paper is never silently dropped. When it cannot supply the scored quantity it carries a machine-readable exclusion_reason , of which five forms occur: number_only_in_figure , figure_only , figure_only_logistic_prior , no_numeric_estimate , and different_unit_of_analysis ; these account for the 5 of 99 papers outside the panel. Values are never interpolated or adjusted toward the existing anchor, and a paper’s different-but-equivalent unit is converted explicitly and noted. Where a panel is empty—possible when an MCM answer is prose or figure only—the task falls back to the single reproduced anchor, and a missing artifact scores 0 0 , so the denominator is always the fixed 18 tasks.
blocks.zh: 纸从不默不作声地掉下. 当它不能提供得分数量时,它携带一个机器可读排除_合理性,其中有五种形式:数字_只_in_图,图_只_只_只_逻辑_前作,无_数字_估计,以及不同的_unit_of_analysis;这些占了板外99个论文中的5个. 价值从未被插入或调整到现有的锚地上,而且纸张的不同但等同的单位被明确转换和注意。 如果一个面板是空的——当一个MCM的答案是传出或仅是图时就有可能——这个任务会回到唯一被复制的锚上,一个缺失的文物得分为0分,所以分母总是固定的18个任务.

blocks.en: A panel also makes disagreement between humans visible instead of hiding it behind one anchor. On mcm-2024-c-tennis-momentum , 10 of 11 outstanding papers conclude that momentum is supported while the reproduced anchor—itself an O-award report—concludes it is not; on that task a model scores 0.909 0.909 if it answers with the majority and 0.091 0.091 if it matches the anchor, so the score reflects which valid statistical test the model chose rather than modeling quality. We mark such literature-split tasks explicitly and exclude them from any headline ranking, while keeping them in the panel: they are the clearest evidence that a single-anchor score would have been arbitrary.
blocks.zh: 一个板子也让人类之间的分歧明显可见,而不是隐藏在一个锚后. 在mcm-2024-c-tennis-momentum上,11份未完成的论文中有10份得出结论认为,势头得到支持,而复制的主播——它本身就是一份O-Award报告——则不认为势头得到支持;在这项任务中,一个模型如果与多数回答,则得分为0.909分;如果与主播匹配,则得分为0.091分;因此,得分反映了该模型选择的、而不是模型质量的、有效的统计测试。 我们明确标出这种被分割的文献任务,并将它们排除在任何头条排名之外,同时将其保留在小组中:它们是最清楚的证据,表明单节计分是任意的.

blocks.en: Relative to the single-anchor board, this changes Robust BO-Eval into a multi-reference gain index against the DeepSeek V4.1 Flash baseline, anchored at 1.0 1.0 : Multi-BO = 1 + clip ⁡ ( O t − f t 1 − f t , − 1 , + 1 ) , \textsc{Multi-BO}\;=\;1+\mathrm{clip}\!\left(\frac{O_{t}-f_{t}}{1-f_{t}},\,-1,\,+1\right), (2) with f t f_{t} the Flash score on task t t and O t O_{t} the model’s, averaged over tasks; when the remaining headroom 1 − f t 1-f_{t} is below 0.10 0.10 we fall back to 1 + clip ⁡ ( O t − f t , ± 0.10 ) 1+\mathrm{clip}(O_{t}-f_{t},\pm 0.10) , and a missing artifact scores − 1 -1 . A value of 1.0 1.0 therefore means “level with Flash”, 1.08 1.08 means “closed 8% of the remaining gap to the human panel”; it is a ratio, not a percentage, and is not comparable to O-Eval .
3.3 Feasibility verification: two layers
blocks.zh: 3.3 可行性核查:两层

blocks.en: Proximity to an anchor does not imply that an answer is physically admissible : a submission can match a reference value on one field while violating a stated constraint on another. TB-MathModel verifies feasibility independently of scoring, in two layers with different trust bases.
blocks.zh: 与锚的相近性并不意味着一个答案在物理上是可以接受的 : 提交可以匹配一个字段的参考值,同时违反对另一个字段的已声明的约束. TB-MathModel独立于得分来验证可行性,分为两层,具有不同的信任基础.

blocks.en: Every task registers one feasibility check, and the registry covers 18/18 tasks; every hard-error branch falls into one of six decidable forms (Appendix Table 12 ). Checks are either structural/domain bounds (rates, correlations, probabilities, non-negative counts, distributions summing to 100, peak ≥ \geq average) or constraint replay (heliostat rated power ≥ 60 \geq 60 MW and installation height ∈ [ 2 , 6 ] \in[2,6] m, dragon-dance head speed × \times amplification ratio ≤ 2 \leq 2 m/s, a demand-capped revenue ceiling, a union duration ≤ \leq the sum of its parts). Three contracts keep the gate honest: coverage (a task cannot ship ungated), oracle self-consistency (the O-award reference must pass its own check), and discrimination (synthetic and real-field violations must be rejected, while an empty artifact warns rather than hard-fails). Four constraints that need an independent replay rather than a field check are recorded as whole-task penalties (Appendix G ).
blocks.zh: 每个任务都登记一次可行性检查,登记册涵盖18/18个任务;每个硬性分支都属于六种可确定形式之一(附录表12)。 检查要么是结构/领域界限(速率、相关率、概率、非负数、分配到100、峰值===================================================================================================================================================================================================================================== 三份合同使大门保持了诚实:覆盖(一项任务不能装船),甲骨文自我一致(O-Award参考书必须经过自己的检查),以及歧视(必须拒绝合成和实时的违反,而空的文物警告而不是硬失败). 需要独立重放而不是实地检查的4个约束被记录为全任务处罚(Appendix G.

blocks.en: To make the gate’s own correctness checkable, Layer 2 re-proves the same invariants as Lean 4 theorems, so the audit rests on the kernel. It generates 624 obligations across all 18 tasks , discharged by decide or omega . No Mathlib is used —the propositions are decidable on exact integers—and values are scaled to integers, so there is no floating-point tolerance; the one exception, a composite index, is declared in the predicate because the tolerance is itself part of the audited assumption. A trust audit ( #print axioms ) reports only [propext, Quot.sound] or none, with no sorryAx and no native_decide (grep-checked). A discrimination suite mutates one numeric leaf at a time and requires the build to fail and to cite the field; ten mutations across all six forms are rejected. Two soft warnings become proofs: a tourism acceptance index is refuted for the unit convention, and a sustainability score fits neither convention within a declared budget.
blocks.zh: 为了让闸门本身的正确性能够被校验,第2层重新证明了与Lean 4定理相同的不变量,因此审计依赖于内核. 它在所有18个任务中产生624项义务,通过决定或Oemaga履行。 没有使用"Mathlib"——命题在精确整数上是可以确定的——并且数值被缩放为整数,所以没有浮点耐受性;一个例外,即综合指数,在上方被宣告,因为耐受性本身是被审计假设的一部分. 信任审计(#print axoms)只报告[propext, Quot. sound] 或无, 无遗憾 Ax 且无本地决定( grep- checked) 。 歧视套房一次会变出一粒数叶,要求积分会失败并引用字段;所有六种形式的10个变相都被拒绝. 两项软警告成为证据:旅游接受指数被否决为单位公约,可持续性分数在宣布的预算中均不符合公约。

blocks.en: The two layers decide every feasibility question that a structured artifact can settle without a model of the physics (Appendix Table 13 ): unit/value ranges (A) and internal consistency (B). Whether the reported value reflects real physical truth (C)—does the field really produce 60 60 MW?—is a property of the world rather than of the artifact, so TB-MathModel verifies it where the problem admits an independent replay. Within this scope the layers are exact: any obligation whose evidence is absent is reported as a witnessed gap rather than silently satisfied, so the audit never overstates what it has proved.
blocks.zh: 两层决定了结构化文物在没有物理模型的情况下可以解决的每一个可行性问题(附录表13):单位/值范围(A)和内部一致性(B). 所报道的数值是否反映了真实的物理真实性(C)——这个领域真的能生产出60兆瓦吗? ——是世界的财产而不是文物的财产,所以TB-MathModel验证了问题所在的允许独立重播的地方. 在这一范围内,层层是准确的:没有证据的任何义务都报告为有目共睹的缺口,而不是沉默地满足,因此审计从未过分夸大其证据。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 设置

blocks.en: We evaluate seven multimodal model/harness entries , whose harness can open the cropped figures. Each entry is run with three seeds per task and reported as a mean with standard deviation; where a model was run at two reasoning tiers we keep the higher-scoring variant. Every row is scored with the same scorer and current anchors, so the board shares one scoring definition (Appendix C ).
blocks.zh: 我们评价7个多式联运模式/缺陷条目,它们的操纵可以打开所收成的数字。 每个条目每个任务有3个种子运行,并报告为有标准偏差的平均值;如果一个模型运行在两个推理层次,我们保留得分较高的变体. 每行都以同名得分者和当前主播打分,因此棋盘共享一分分定义(Appendix C.

blocks.en: The prompt is the task’s instruction file, passed verbatim: the contest statement, the cited figures inline, and a fixed “Required Benchmark Artifact” block naming the output path (Appendix E ). Tasks run in Docker containers— python:3.12-slim with a fixed scientific stack, internet disabled , model traffic through a local retry proxy—so an agent cannot fetch solutions or install packages at run time; limits are 2 CPUs, 8 GB, no GPU, and a 4-hour timeout (Appendix B ). Each multimodal entry is run three times per task and reported as a mean with standard deviation; the one well-posed task, dragon-dance, is additionally probed four times, where the answers agreed to machine precision ( std = 4.6 × 10 − 16 4.6\times 10^{-16} ).

blocks.en: Each model is driven by an agent harness, so a natural question is whether the score reflects the model or the harness. Table 3 holds the model fixed and varies the harness, using DeepSeek-Flash and four harnesses. The score is essentially invariant: O-Eval moves only 0.07 0.07 pp across all four ( 59.81 59.81 – 59.88 59.88 ), far inside the per-seed deviation, and the relative index moves in the same narrow band. A model’s own harness fits it marginally better—DeepSeek’s native harness gives the highest O-Eval ( 59.88 59.88 ) and Multi-BO ( 1.092 1.092 )—but the difference is small. The board therefore measures the model far more than the harness it is wrapped in.

blocks.en: 4.3 Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.3 分析

blocks.en: Per-task O-Eval for four representative entries is in Appendix Table 6 . Three patterns stand out. (a) The CUMCM–MCM gap is large and model-dependent. For the weaker entries, CUMCM cells sit near 100% while MCM cells sit between 0% and 60%: the engineering problems have well-defined final numbers most models reach, whereas MCM problems are more open and their anchors more contestable. The strongest entries narrow the gap only slightly (GPT-6 82.9 on CUMCM vs. 46.2 on MCM; GPT-5.5 79.7 vs. 39.8). A sizeable share of tasks is now solved near-perfectly—expected of a current benchmark—and the board’s discrimination comes from the open-ended MCM problems. (b) Two tasks are all-or-nothing. On mcm-2024-b-submersible every entry scores 100%, while on mcm-2024-c-tennis even the flagships score below 40%. Such tasks either fall inside or outside the panel’s tolerance entirely, so they separate regimes of models but not models within one. (c) Many low scores reflect reference scale/scope, not modeling error. Several tasks contain a metric whose model/panel ratio exceeds 5 × 5\times : a host-fish index reported near 1080 by some papers while models give a normalised [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] quantity; a sustainability score near 1.007 against models reporting a 0–100 utility; a 6 × 6 6\times 6 grid against models discretising the same region into hundreds of cells; and a → 73.52 72.67\!\to\!73.52 band in which the paper’s own baseline scores zero.

blocks.en: An anchor-based benchmark is only as credible as its anchors, so we audited every scoring rule and anchor and report what the audit changed (Appendix G ). Two gate false positives were removed without moving any score, and degenerate-band widening affected one cell ( + 0.35 +0.35 pp). Excluding two non-comparable-unit metrics raised every entry by 0.05–2.62 pp—the signature of a systematic scoring effect rather than a model difference. Most consequentially, the audit flagged the dragon-dance anchor as physically infeasible and we corrected it (Section 4.2 ).
blocks.zh: 以锚定为基础的基准只能像其锚定一样可信,因此我们审计了每个打分规则和锚定,并报告了审计的变化(附录G)。 两道门假阳性被取出而未移动任何分数,变质-波段拓宽会影响一格(+0.35+0.35pp). 不包括两个不可比较单位的衡量标准,每个条目都增加了0.05至2.62页,即系统评分效应的标志,而不是模型差异。 因此,审计将 " 龙舞 " 锚标为不可行,我们予以纠正(第4.2节)。

blocks.en: The gate hard-invalidated 7 cells, concentrated on heliostat (rated power below 60 MW, or a mirror below the 2 m minimum) plus single cells for smoke-screen, Juneau, and Olympic. The Lean layer turns two soft warnings into proofs and proves non-vacuity by accepting a corrected artifact under the predicate that rejects the reported one. On the one numerically well-posed task the runs agree to machine precision, and across the board the per-seed deviations stay small relative to the spread between entries (Table 2 ), so rankings do not depend on the seed.
blocks.zh: 大门硬性失效了7个细胞,集中在平流层上(功率低于60兆瓦,或低于最低2米的一面镜子)外加单细胞,用于烟幕,Juneau和奥运会. 利恩地层将两次软警告变为证明,并通过接受拒绝报告内容的上游下修正文物来证明非挥发. 在一个数字性强的任务上,跑队同意机器精度,从总体上看,每个种子的偏差相对于条目之间的相差(表2)保持了小的距离,因此排名不取决于种子.

blocks.en: 4.4 From Findings to Model Development
blocks.zh: 4.4 从调查结果到模型开发

blocks.en: TB-MathModel is meant to improve models, not only rank them. Three levers follow from the findings above, and each is trainable with signals TB-MathModel already produces.
blocks.zh: TB-MathModel的本意是改进模型,不仅将它们排出分级. 从上述结论中可以看出三个杠杆,每个杠杆都有TB-MathModel已经产生的信号。

blocks.en: Verified reward for RL. The feasible, oracle-normalised score is an executable, reproducible reward—every submission passes the gate and the Lean layer. Rejection-sampling (keep and rank gate-accepted trajectories by O-Eval ) works today; group-relative policy optimisation with the gate as a hard multiplier teaches the model to satisfy the physics before chasing the reference. The dragon-dance case motivates this: twelve models computed the right peak but were penalised, so what they lack is self-checking—exactly what a verifier in the reward provides.
blocks.zh: 验证RL的奖励. 可行的、神谕正常的分数是可执行的、可重复的奖励——每一份呈文都经过大门和利安地层。 拒绝-采样(O-Eval保持并排出门接受的轨迹)今天是可行的;以门为硬倍数的组合-相对政策优化,在追逐参考之前教导模型满足物理. " 龙舞 " 案的动机是:12个模型计算出正确的峰值,但却受到惩罚,因此它们缺乏的是自我检查——确切地说,在奖励中核查者提供了什么。

blocks.en: Targets against the observed failures. Finding (a)—the open-ended MCM suite separates quality while CUMCM saturates—says to train assumptions, formulation, and sensitivity rather than closed-form solving; finding (c)—many losses are unit and scale mismatches—says to state and verify units, ranges, and schema before emitting a number. Both are rewarded directly by the artifact contract.
blocks.zh: 目标与观察到的失败。 发现(a)——不限成员名额的MCM套件在质量上与CUMCM饱和相分离——说要训练假设、配制和敏感性,而不是封闭式的解决; 发现(c)——许多损失是单位和比例不匹配——说要说明和核实单位、幅度和计划,然后排放一个数字。 两者都直接受到文物合同的奖励.

blocks.en: Feasibility the artifact can check. The dragon-dance audit exposes the failure a value-range check cannot: a consistent answer that is physically inadmissible because the artifact omits the evidence (no per-mirror layout, no peak-neighbourhood sample). Training models to emit that witness raises the score and makes them checkable, reaching level C.
blocks.zh: 文物的可行性可以检查。 " 龙舞"审计揭露了故障 一个数值范围检查不能:一个一致的答案,由于文物省略了证据(没有偶联布局,没有高峰-邻里样本),因此在物理上不能接受. 释放证人的培训模式提高了分数,使其可以核查,达到C级。

blocks.en: Three roles—a top proprietary agent, the oracle, and the low-cost open agent—are compared on three problems in Appendix F . On dragon-dance all three converge while the paper’s value is the infeasible outlier, so the models were right and our anchor was wrong. On crop-planting the paper’s constraints are jointly infeasible, so we anchor on a reproducible exact MILP optimum. On Juneau the sustainability score is reported on different unit scales, which is why the task schema , not the scorer, must pin a field’s range.
blocks.zh: 附录F中的三个问题比较了三个角色——顶级专有代理,即甲骨文和低成本开放代理。 在龙舞中,三者都凝聚在一起,而纸的价值是无法实现的,所以模型是正确的,我们的锚是错误的。 在作物种植方面,纸张的制约是共同的不可行的,因此我们只能依靠可复制的精确的MILP最佳产品。 在Juneau, 可持续性得分以不同的单位尺度报告, 这就是为什么任务计划而不是计分员必须标出一个字段的范围。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented TB-MathModel, the first agentic and verifiable terminal benchmark of 18 real mathematical-modeling problems, distinguished by direction-aware, one-sided scoring that never penalises beating the anchor, and two-layer feasibility verification combining a gate over six decidable invariant forms with 624 kernel-checked Lean obligations.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了TB-MathModel,这是18个真正的数学模型问题的首个可验证的代理性终端基准,以方向感知为区分,片面的分数永远不会惩罚打锚者,以及两个层次的可行性核查,将一个门与624个内核核对的6个可变形式相结合。

blocks.en: Scoring each task against a panel of human outstanding papers, the newest flagships lead across seven multimodal entries (GPT-6 Astra at O-Eval 64.58 % 64.58\% , Fable 5.1 at 63.11 % 63.11\% ), while the $2.54 open DeepSeek-Flash holds 59.81 % 59.81\% at 1 / 100 1/100 the cost. We documented the scoring pitfalls we fixed, and showed a case where the benchmark itself was wrong and the models were right.
blocks.zh: 最新旗舰将每项任务与一组人类杰出论文相比,领先于7个多式联运条目(GPT-6 Astra at O-Eval 64.58% 64.58% ;Fable 5.1 at 63.11% 63.11% ;而2.54开通的DeepSeek-Flash 持有59.81% 59.81% 59.100美元的成本。 我们记录了我们解决的积分陷阱, 并展示了一个案例, 基准本身是错误的,模型是正确的。

blocks.en: The two-layer design is the transferable idea: a fast gate covers every task and a proof assistant makes the audit’s own correctness machine-checkable, while stating what neither can answer. Because TB-MathModel gives a reproducible reward, its trajectories are also training material, and Section 4.4 turns the findings into directions.
blocks.zh: 双层设计是可转移的想法:一个快门可以覆盖每个任务,一个证明助理可以使审计本身的正确性机器检查,同时说明两者都不能回答的问题. 由于TB-MathModel给出了可再生的奖励,其轨迹也是培训材料,而第4.4节将调查结果转化为方向.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: TB-MathModel normalises each task against a reproducible Outstanding-award solution, with per-anchor provenance so any reference can be re-derived; because modeling admits no single correct answer, the natural extension is a multi-paper panel reporting a spread over accepted solutions. The two verification layers decide every feasibility question a structured artifact can settle (unit/value ranges and internal consistency); external physical truth is a property of the world, so it is checked where a problem admits an independent replay, and any obligation whose evidence is missing is reported rather than silently passed. Panel size varies with the number of outstanding reports per problem (1 to 18 papers), and where humans themselves disagree—as on the tennis momentum test, where 10 of 11 papers reach the opposite conclusion from the anchor—we mark the task literature-split and keep it out of headline rankings. Scores are three-seed means, and the task shell carries over to engineering and cross-disciplinary problems.
blocks.zh: TB-MathModel将每个任务与可复制的杰出授标解决方案相抗衡,每根Anchor出处可以使任何参考文献重新出处;因为建模没有承认单一的正确答案,自然延伸是一个多纸面的面板,报告分布在被接受的解决方案上. 两个核查层决定一个结构化的文物可以解决的每一个可行性问题(单位/价值范围和内部一致性);外部的物理真理是世界的财产,因此在某个问题承认独立重播的地方加以检查,任何缺少证据的义务都会被报告而不是默默地传递. 小组的规模因每个问题(1至18篇论文)的未交报告数量而异,如果人类本身不同意的话——例如网球势头测试,11篇论文中有10篇从主播处得出了相反的结论——我们标出任务文献的分解并把它排除在头条排名之外。 分数是"三种子"手段,任务外壳会延续到工程和跨学科的问题.

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: Statements, attachments, and figures are official CUMCM and MCM material used for research evaluation; we do not redistribute Outstanding-award solutions, and reproduction code derives from a public corpus with per-task provenance. Users should confirm the licence terms for their own redistribution. TB-MathModel measures and improves the modeling workflow of LLM agents rather than automating work presented as a team’s own, and entirely automated evaluation keeps the cost of broad participation low.
blocks.zh: 声明、附件和数字是用于研究评价的CUMCM和MCM的官方材料;我们不重新分配杰出的奖励解决方案,复制代码来自每个任务来源的公文。 用户应当确认自身再分配的许可条件. TB-MathModel测量和改进LLM代理的建模工作流程,而不是将作为团队自己的工作自动化,完全自动化的评价保持了广泛参与的成本低.

blocks.en: Use of Large Language Models
blocks.zh: 大语言模型的使用

blocks.en: LLMs served as the systems under test —every entry in Table 2 is an LLM agent, which is the object of measurement—and as writing assistants that helped draft prose and check the internal consistency of L a T e X and numbers. Benchmark construction, scoring rules, feasibility checks, and Lean obligations were specified, implemented, and verified by the authors, and all numerical results are produced by the released scripts.
blocks.zh: LLMs作为测试中的系统——表2的每一个条目都是LLM剂,这是测量的对象——以及作为书写助手,帮助起草出品并检查L a T e X和数字的内部一致性. 基准构建,评分规则,可行性检查,和利恩义务均由作者规定,执行并核实,所有数字结果由所发布的脚本产生.

blocks.en: B.5 Network isolation

blocks.en: Every task disables internet access. Model traffic is routed through a local retry proxy, so an agent can call the model API but cannot fetch solutions, download packages, or install tooling at run time. Because installation is impossible after a trial starts, CLI agents ( codex , opencode , claude-code ) must be present in the image; the third-party operator’s runs pre-installed the CLIs at the end of the Dockerfile and allow-listed only the model gateway, leaving the statement, data, and verifier unchanged.
blocks.zh: 每项任务都会禁用互联网。 模型流量通过本地重试代理进行路由,因此代理可以调用模型API,但无法在运行时获取解决方案,下载软件包,或安装工具. 由于在试验开始后安装是不可能的,所以CLI代理(codex,opencode,claude-code)必须在图像中存在;第三方运营商运行在多克文件的结尾处预先安装了CLI,并允许只列出模型网关,使语句,数据和验证器保持不变.

blocks.en: C.3 Retries, concurrency, and artifact recovery
blocks.zh: C.3 退货、货币和文物回收

blocks.en: All entries used one concurrent trial and no automatic retries; each of the three seeds is an independent pass over the 18 tasks. Two subtleties are disclosed. First, misfiled artifacts : two tasks wrote the result with a hyphen instead of the required underscore, so the harness did not collect it; we replayed the recorded run’s scripts to reproduce the artifact and re-scored it. Second, third-party runs : the GPT-6 Astra and Fable 5.1 entries were run by independent operators; because their verifier used a different reward formula, we re-scored their saved artifacts with our scorer and current anchors so that all entries share one scoring definition. Where an artifact was not packaged, we reconstructed the scored fields from the saved per-metric records, verified to reproduce the operator’s own numbers exactly on the tasks where the full artifact was present.
blocks.zh: 所有条目都使用一个同时试验,没有自动复试;三个种子中每个种子都是一个独立通过18个任务. 二微妙所显. 首先,错误的文物:两个任务用连字符而不是必要的下划线来写结果,因此,吊带没有收集;我们重放记录的跑步脚本来复制文物并重新打分。 第二,第三方运行:GPT-6 Astra和Fable 5.1条目由独立运营商运行;由于他们的验证人使用不同的奖励公式,我们用我们的分数和当前主播重新打分他们的被保存文物,从而使所有条目共享一个分数定义. 在没有包装文物的地方,我们从保存的每分量记录中重建了有分量的田地,经过核实可以复制操作员自己的号码,确切地记录了完整的文物所在的任务。

blocks.en: C.4 Cost accounting
blocks.zh: 第C.4节 成本核算

blocks.en: Cost is computed from measured token usage against a fixed price snapshot, with two conservative adjustments stated in the report: reasoning tokens that a provider bills outside its completion counter are added to output, and where a provider charges a peak/off-peak rate, the peak rate is used. For the two third-party entries, cost is their own measured per-run USD. Because the pricing file is local and fixed, costs do not drift between reruns.
blocks.zh: 成本是从一个固定价格快照的量度符号使用量计算出来的,报告中有两种保守的调整:推理符号:在完成计数器外的供货商账单被添加到产出上;如果供货商收取峰值/峰值外利率,则使用峰值率. 对于两个第三方条目,成本是它们自己计算的每笔支出的美元。 由于定价文件是本地的并固定的,所以成本不会在重跑之间漂移.

blocks.en: Appendix D Baseline Information
blocks.zh: 附录D 资料

blocks.en: The word “baseline” is overloaded in this benchmark; we distinguish three distinct objects so that the numbers are unambiguous.
blocks.zh: 在这个基准中,“基线”一词过重;我们区分出三个不同的物体,以便数字明确无误。

blocks.en: D.1 The flash baseline (score normalisation)
blocks.zh: D.1 联合国 闪光基线( 分数正常化)

blocks.en: Robust BO-Eval is computed against a single reference submission , the DeepSeek V4 Flash baseline run on the same tasks. It defines the zero point: Robust BO-Eval normalises the model–baseline gain by the oracle–baseline gap. It is a model submission, not a curated baseline panel.
blocks.zh: 强力BO-Eval根据单一的参考材料计算,DeepSeek V4闪光基线运行在相同的任务上。 它定义了零点: robust BO-Eval使模型–由oracle–baseline间隙得到的基线收益正常化. 这是一个模型提交材料,而不是一个经过整理的基准面板。

blocks.en: D.2 The Outstanding anchor (score ceiling)
blocks.zh: D.2 联合国 未决锚(分数上限)

blocks.en: Each task’s ceiling is the reproduction of one Outstanding-award paper, which is the value that scores O-Eval = 100 % =100\% . Table 8 lists the anchor paper identifier for each task. Each anchor is a runnable script that reads the official attachments and emits the artifact JSON, plus a committed expected result recording its values; coverage is 18/18.
blocks.zh: 每项任务的上限是复制一份未完成的授标纸,即O-Eval = 100% = 100 = 100% = 100% = 。表8列出了每项任务的锚地纸标识符。 每个主播是一个可运行的脚本,读取官方附件并出出文物JSON,加上承诺的预期结果记录其值;覆盖范围为18/18.

blocks.en: Table 8: Outstanding-award anchor per task.
blocks.zh: 表8:每项任务的杰出锚地。

blocks.en: D.3 Legacy per-task baseline endpoints
blocks.zh: D.3 联合国 按任务分列的基准终点

blocks.en: Fifteen of the 18 tasks use the legacy target-distance-to-Outstanding mode with a baseline endpoint; three (Wordle, stair-wear, and Juneau tourism) use true per-metric baseline-to-Outstanding min–max endpoints. The distinction is recorded per metric in each scoring configuration and surfaced in the per-task tables.
blocks.zh: 在18项任务中,有15项使用带有基线终点的遗留目标-距离-离地模式;有3项(Wordle、楼梯-穿戴和Juneau旅游)使用真实的每个计量基线-离地分-最大终点。 这种区别在每个评分配置中记录每个公分,并在每个任务表中浮出水面。

blocks.en: D.4 Anchor caveats
blocks.zh: D.4 联合国 锁定提醒

blocks.en: Two anchors carry caveats that affect how their scores should be read. Crop-planting is a marked special case: the paper’s full constraint set is jointly infeasible on the official attachments and its reported value came from an undisclosed heuristic, so the anchor is a reproducible exact MILP optimum under the paper’s per-plot demand cap. Dragon-dance was corrected: the paper’s 1.406276 m/s is infeasible (a handle would reach 2.2568 m/s), so the anchor is the continuous-time value 1.246266 m/s and the metric direction is target_value . Both are examples of the general principle that an anchor is a reproduction of one team’s choices, and that its provenance must be inspectable.
blocks.zh: 两个主播带有的警告会影响他们的分数应如何被读取. 种植作物是一个显著的特例:在官方附件上,纸张的充分约束装置是共同不可行的,其报告的价值来自一种不公开的heuristic,因此锚在纸张的每片需求上限下是一个可复制的精确MILP最佳. Dragon-Dance被纠正:纸的1.406276米/秒不可行(一个手柄会达到2.2568米/秒),因此锚地为连续时间值1.246266米/秒,而公尺方向为目标-值. 两者都是一个主播就是一个团队选择的再现的一般原则的例子,其出处必须是可以检查的.

blocks.en: Appendix E Prompt Design
blocks.zh: 附录 E 即时设计

blocks.en: E.1 The prompt is the task statement
blocks.zh: E.1 联合国 提示是任务说明

blocks.en: There is no hand-written prompt wrapper in this benchmark. The prompt is the task’s instruction file, delivered verbatim by the harness. Its structure is fixed across tasks: a machine-readable canary comment (stripped before delivery); an “Original Contest Problem” section containing the verbatim statement with each cited figure embedded inline; any results tables the statement requires, as plain text; a note listing the in-container figure paths; a “Required Benchmark Artifact” section; and the time-limit line.
blocks.zh: 在这个基准中没有手写即时包装. 提示是任务的指示文件, 它的结构固定在各种任务之间:一个机器可读的金丝雀评论(在交付前被划出);一个“原始竞争问题”部分,其中包含每个被引用的图表内嵌的逐字记录;任何结果表,作为纯文本;一个列出容器内图表路径的说明;一个“必要的基准艺术”部分;以及时限线。

blocks.zh: E.2 联合国 文物块( verbatim 模板)

blocks.en: E.3 Harness wrapping
blocks.zh: E.3 利用包装

blocks.en: The harnesses deliver the same text differently. Each CLI harness prepends its own generic command-line system prompt and then supplies the statement as the positional prompt.
blocks.zh: 绳子传送的文字不同 每个 CLI 使用预置它自己的通用命令行系统即时,然后作为位置即时提供语句.

blocks.en: E.4 Version caveat
blocks.zh: E.4 版本说明

blocks.en: The instruction files were revised after some trials were recorded: a figure-path section was added, and one MCM statement was re-sourced from the official PDF. The prompt actually delivered in a given trial is the one captured in that trial’s log; for reproducibility, cite those, not the current file. This is why we describe the prompt structure above rather than quoting today’s file as if it were what every model saw.
blocks.zh: 在记录了一些审判之后,对指令文件进行了修订:增加了一个数字路径部分,并从官方PDF重新提供了一份MCM声明。 在某一审判中实际交付的即时文件是该审判记录中记录的即时文件;为了可复制,引述这些,而不是目前的档案。 这就是为什么我们描述上面的迅速结构,而不是引用今天的档案,仿佛每个模型都看到的那样。

blocks.en: E.5 What the prompt withholds by design
blocks.zh: E.5 联合国 即时扣下什么 设计

blocks.en: By design the prompt is a pure task description: no modeling hints, no method suggestions, and no pointer to the scored fields beyond the schema. It leaves the agent to infer which numbers matter, which keeps the setting a test of the whole modeling problem rather than a fill-in-the-schema exercise. This keeps the benchmark a test of doing the whole modeling problem, at the cost of the agent having to infer which numbers matter.
blocks.zh: 通过设计,提示是一个纯任务描述:没有建模提示,没有方法建议,也没有指向计划以外的得分字段. 它让代理人来推断哪些数字很重要,它使设定测试整个建模问题的过程持续进行,而不是一个填充式的练习. 这使基准成为处理整个建模问题的检验标准,其代价是代理人不得不推断哪些数字很重要。

blocks.zh: 附录F 案例研究

blocks.zh: 我们给出了三个案例研究的每个实地的全面比较。 从每个角色保存的文物中读取值;神谕柱为主播. 所有三个表格都横跨两栏。

The exact identity head_speed × \times ratio = 2 =2 m/s, checked by both the programmatic gate and the Lean layer, is what exposes the paper value as infeasible: the paper’s isolated value 1.406276 m/s (with ratio 1.422195) implies 2.2568 m/s at a handle.

blocks.zh: 报纸的全套限制套件在官方附件上是行不通的,因此锚点是可复制的MILP最佳,模型的计划处于同一制度。 主播位于折扣栏上的两个模型之间,这就是为什么一个单个scalar不能概括这个任务的原因.

blocks.en: Table 11: Juneau tourism (MCM 2025 B, final question). The sustainability score is reported on different unit scales by different agents.
blocks.zh: 表11:Juneau旅游业(MCM 2025 B,最后问题)。 不同代理人在不同单位尺度上报告可持续性分数。

blocks.en: This is the clearest scale problem. The anchor is on a ∼ \sim 1 unit scale; one third-party agent reports the same field on a 0–100 “multiattribute utility” scale that it explicitly declares in its own artifact. Because the task’s output schema does not pin the range, the agent is not wrong—which is why the correct repair is to specify the field’s range in the schema, not to rescale in the scorer.
blocks.zh: 这是最明显的尺度问题。 锚在 \ sim 1 个单位尺度上;一个第三方代理以 0-100 个 " 多属性用途 " 尺度报告同一领域,这是它在其自己的文物中明确申报的。 因为任务输出计划没有标出范围,所以代理商没有错——这就是为什么正确的修复是在计划中指定了球场范围,而不是在计分器中重新标出.

blocks.en: F.1 Discussion
blocks.zh: F.1 讨论情况

blocks.en: Dragon-dance. The paper’s isolated value (1.406276) is the wrong one. This case matters most because it inverts the usual story: the models were right and the reference was wrong, and the fix was to the benchmark. It also shows why the feasibility layer is not redundant with scoring—“ratio × \times head speed = 2 =2 m/s” is an exact identity that both layers check, and it is what made the paper value’s infeasibility visible.
blocks.zh: 龙舞. 报纸的孤立价值(1.406276)是错误的. 这起案件最为重要,因为它颠倒了通常的故事:模型正确而引用错误,而定律是基准. 这也说明了为什么可行性层不与得分相重复——"ratio ×\times head speed = 2 = 2 m/s"是两个地层都检查过的确切身份,正是这个身份使得纸值不可行性明显.

blocks.en: Crop-planting. GPT-5.5 and DeepSeek produce plan profits in the same regime, and the optimum sits between them on one column—which is why a single scalar cannot summarise the task. When the human paper is not reproducible, the honest move is to anchor on a reproducible value and mark it, not to penalise models for matching an irreproducible number.
blocks.zh: 农作物种植. GPT-5.5和DeepSeek在同一体制中产生计划利润,最佳的利润放在一栏上——这就是为什么单张标语不能概括任务的原因。 当人造纸无法再出时,诚实的举动是将可再出值固定在可再出值上并作标记,而不是惩罚匹配不可再出数的模型.

blocks.en: Juneau. The oracle recommends an 11,000/day cap at 55 USD with a sustainability score of 1.007, GPT-5.5 recommends 20,000/day at 20 USD on its own 0–1 scale, and DeepSeek recommends 16,000/day at 30 USD. This argues that the task schema —not just the scorer—must state a field’s range and units, which is a fix to the task rather than to the code.
blocks.zh: 琼瑙. 预告片建议设定11,000美元/日的上限为55美元,可持续性分数为1.007;GPT-5.5建议设定20万美元/日的上限为0-1;DeepSeek建议设定16,000美元/日的上限为30美元。 这说明任务计划——不仅仅是计分员——必须说明一个战地的范围和单位,这是对任务而不是代码的固定。

blocks.en: Appendix G Scoring Details
blocks.zh: 附录 G 分类细节

blocks.en: G.1 The metric panel
blocks.zh: G.1 联合国 计量面板

blocks.en: Every task ships a scoring configuration declaring its scored metrics. A metric entry specifies a path into the artifact, an oracle value, optional baseline and outstanding values, a direction (with a matching semantic direction), a normalisation mode, and a weight. Across the 18 tasks there are 60 scored metrics ; one further Wordle metric is declared at weight 0 and recorded but excluded from the panel. The per-task counts are in Table 5 .

blocks.zh: G.3 不包括的衡量尺度

blocks.en: G.4 Hard-gate decisions
blocks.zh: G.4 硬门决定

blocks.en: Seven whole-task penalties were applied across the entries: four heliostat violations (rated power below 60 MW, or a mirror below the 2 m minimum), one smoke-screen plan failing an independent coverage replay, one Juneau answer with unit-invalid acceptance/sustainability values, and one Olympic answer with a degenerate coach-effect result.
blocks.zh: 在整个条目中适用了7个全任务处罚:4个恒星违规(分级功率低于60兆瓦,或一个镜子低于最低分数2米),1个烟幕计划未实现独立覆盖重播,1个Juneau回答单位无效接受/持续值,1个奥运回答结果已退化教练效应.

blocks.en: G.5 Pitfalls found and fixed
blocks.zh: G.5 发现并修复的坑道

blocks.en: An anchor-based benchmark is only as credible as its anchors, so we audited the scoring rules and anchors and report what the audit changed. Two gate false positives (a signed elasticity read as a negative count; a missing field read as a hard contradiction) were corrected but changed no score, and degenerate-band widening moved one score ( + 0.35 +0.35 pp for v4 pro). Non-comparable-unit exclusion raised every entry by 0.05–2.62 pp, since the penalty applied to all submissions equally—the signature of a systematic scoring error rather than a model difference. Finally, the dragon-dance anchor was itself physically infeasible: the paper’s 1.406276 m/s would drive a handle to 1.406276 × 1.604793 = 2.2568 1.406276\times 1.604793=2.2568 m/s, above the 2 m/s cap, because it maximised over integer seconds and stepped over the true continuous-time peak at t = 14.48 t=14.48 s. We corrected the anchor to 1.246266 m/s; twelve of the evaluated models had reported the correct value and had been sitting at 49.82%, while the two matching the erroneous paper value had been at 100%. Here the benchmark, not the model, was wrong (Appendices G and H ).
blocks.zh: 以锚定为基础的基准仅能与其锚定者一样可信,因此我们审计了评分规则和锚定者,并报告了审计的变化。 两门假阳性(一个签名弹性读作负数;一个缺失的字段读作硬相矛盾)被纠正了,但没有改变分数,而退化的波段拓宽移动了一分(v4 prop). 不可比较单位的排除使每一条条目都增加了0.05至2.62页,因为惩罚同样适用于所有提交书——即系统计分错误的签名,而不是模型差异的签名。 最后,龙舞锚本身在物理上是行不通的:纸张的1.406276米/秒会驱动一个手柄到1.406276×1.604793=2.2568 1.406276\times 1.604793=2.2568米/秒,高于2米/秒的上限,因为它能最大地超过整数秒并踩出真正的连续时间峰值为t=14.48t=14.48s. 我们把锚定值修正为1.246266米/秒;12个被评价的模型报告了正确的值并一直坐以49.82%,而两个匹配错误的纸张值的模型是100%。 这里的基准而不是模型是错误的(附录G和H)。

blocks.en: G.6 Degenerate-band and validity rules
blocks.zh: G.6 脱原带和有效性规则

blocks.en: The band-widening rule applies to the endpoint metrics of the three endpoint-style tasks. Applying all scoring fixes in this paper moved every entry upward by 0.05–2.62 pp, because the affected penalties applied to all submissions equally—the diagnostic signature of a systematic scoring error rather than a model difference.
blocks.zh: 宽幅规则适用于三个端点式任务的端点度量. 适用本文中的所有分数修正办法,使每一分数向上移动了0.05至2.62页,因为受影响的惩罚同样适用于所有提交材料,即系统分数错误的诊断标志,而不是模型差异。

blocks.en: H.4 Discrimination suite
blocks.zh: H.4 歧视套间

blocks.en: The discrimination script mutates one numeric leaf at a time and requires the build to fail and to cite the mutated field. Ten mutations across the six forms are covered (out-of-range probability, out-of-range correlation, reversed ordering, violated exact identity, non-positive thickness, reversed interval, non-binary decision bit, negative acceptance index, q 95 q_{95} below mean, zero species count). All ten are rejected; the suite exits non-zero if any is not.
blocks.zh: 歧视剧本一次会变出一个数字叶,需要构建失败并引用变种场. 覆盖了6种形态的10个突变(出场概率,出场关联,倒置顺序,侵犯准确身份,非正向厚度,倒置间隔,非二进制决定位,负接受指数,q 95 q_{95}下同值,零物种计数). 所有10个都被拒绝;如果没有,套房出口为非零。

blocks.en: H.5 Reproducing the layer
blocks.zh: H.5 复制地层

blocks.en: Toolchain is Lean 4 via elan, with no Mathlib; a clean build completes in about a second. The generator also runs against the committed Outstanding-award references, so the layer can be exercised without the saved agent artifacts.
blocks.zh: Toolchain是Lean 4通过elan,没有Mathlib;一个干净的建筑大约在一秒内完成. 生成器也与承诺的杰出授勋参考物相抗衡,因此没有被保存的物剂文物,层能被行使.
